title: 第 9 讲：高频词群实战 I — 高频动词搭配网

reading.title: What Developers Do All Day

sentences.en: What do developers actually do all day?
sentences.zh: 开发者每天到底在干什么？

sentences.en: We get tickets, take notes, make decisions, and set priorities.
sentences.zh: 我们领工单、记笔记、做决定、定优先级。

sentences.en: We keep the builds green and run the tests.
sentences.zh: 我们让构建保持绿色，把测试跑起来。

sentences.en: When a bug shows up, we get to the bottom of it: reproduce it, fix it, and take notes for next time.
sentences.zh: bug 出现时，我们把它查个水落石出：复现它、修掉它、为下次记好笔记。

sentences.en: Good teams make time for review and set clear rules; they never get tired of asking why.
sentences.zh: 好的团队会留出评审时间、定下清晰的规则；他们从不厌倦多问一句为什么。

sentences.en: My butler helps too — it sends me a summary, checks every task, and keeps the scripts running.
sentences.zh: 管家也在帮忙——它给我发摘要、检查每个任务、让脚本持续运行。

sentences.en: You get better one small fix at a time: take it slow, make it work, set it free.
sentences.zh: 你每次一小修，就变强一分：慢一点来，让它能用，然后放手。

sentences.en: Keep it simple, run it often, and let good habits compound.
sentences.zh: 保持简单，经常运行，让好习惯复利生长。

reading.translation: 开发者每天到底在干什么？我们领工单、记笔记、做决定、定优先级。我们让构建保持绿色，把测试跑起来。bug 出现时，我们把它查个水落石出：复现它、修掉它、为下次记好笔记。好的团队会留出评审时间、定下清晰的规则；他们从不厌倦多问一句为什么。管家也在帮忙——它给我发摘要、检查每个任务、让脚本持续运行。你每次一小修，就变强一分：慢一点来，让它能用，然后放手。保持简单，经常运行，让好习惯复利生长。

keyPoints.sentence: We get tickets, take notes, make decisions, and set priorities.
keyPoints.analysis: 四大动词各带一个「万能宾语」— 英语的地道感来自动词 × 宾语的搭配，而非生僻词

keyPoints.sentence: we get to the bottom of it
keyPoints.analysis: get 搭配：查个水落石出（= 彻底弄清）
keep + 宾语 + doing：让……持续运行（keep 的使役用法，升级讲内容）

core.example: You get better one small fix at a time.
core.extraExample: Get the facts first; opinions come later.
core.collocations: get tickets 领工单 ｜ get to the bottom of 查到底 ｜ get better 变强 ｜ get tired of 厌倦 ｜ get started 开始

core.extraExample: Take five minutes to name things properly.
core.collocations: take notes 记笔记 ｜ take it slow 慢慢来 ｜ take time 花时间 ｜ take over 接管 ｜ take care 保重

core.example: Good teams make time for review.
core.extraExample: Make the change small enough to review quickly.
core.extraExampleZh: 把改动做得小到能快速评审。
core.collocations: make decisions 做决定 ｜ make time 挤时间 ｜ make it work 让它可用 ｜ make mistakes 犯错 ｜ make sense 说得通

core.extraExample: Set clear boundaries between work and rest.
core.extraExampleZh: 给工作和休息划清界限。
core.collocations: set priorities 定优先级 ｜ set clear rules 定规则 ｜ set up 搭建 ｜ set a reminder 设提醒 ｜ set free 释放

blocks.text: 逐词翻译：做 决定 → ❌ do a decision；块状调用：**make a decision** ✅（动词与宾语是**固定搭档**，不可互换）。

rows: take a decision（英式正式用法，美式少用）
make up your mind ≠ take up

notes.heading: keep 的使役结构（升级讲核心）

blocks.text: keep + 宾语 + doing：**让某物持续做某事** — it keeps the scripts **running**（让脚本持续运行）；Sorry to keep you **waiting**。
对照 L01 的 keep it simple（keep + 宾 + adj）：keep 后可接形容词或 -ing，语义都是「维持」。

output.prompt: 用 3 句复述「开发者的一天」，每句至少含一个本讲搭配。
output.reference: 线索：日常四件事 → 出 bug 时 → 好团队的习惯
output.sample:
Every day we get tickets, take notes, make decisions, and set priorities. （四大动词各带万能宾语）When a bug shows up, we get to the bottom of it: reproduce it, fix it, and take notes for next time. （get to the bottom of）Good teams make time for review and keep the builds green. （make time / keep + 宾 + adj）
（范文仅供参考：每句至少含一个本讲搭配即可，不要求逐词一致。）

output.prompt: 用 get / take / make / set 各写 2 句真实工作场景（共 8 句），再用升级讲 keep / run 各写 1 句。
output.reference:
参考起点：
I get a coffee before the standup.
We make a decision in the review meeting.
Keep the branch small; run the tests locally.
output.sample:
I get a coffee before the standup. （get + 名词）
Take your time with the migration. （take 搭配）
We make a decision in the review meeting. （make a decision）
Set a reminder for the release day. （set a reminder）
Keep the builds green before every push. （keep + 宾 + adj）
The pipeline runs smoothly after the fix. （run smoothly）

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: 8 句 = get / take / make / set 各 2 句 + keep / run 各 1 句；场景真实

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: 对照搭配网 — 有没有自造「do a decision」类假搭配；keep / run 用的是升级搭配而非重复旧账

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 10 句搭配全部成立，即通过

practice.title: 选词填空 — get / take / make / set，注意形态

questions.stem: We need to ___ a decision before the demo.
questions.explanation: make a decision 固定搭配（make 造出结果）

questions.stem: She ___ notes during every code review.
questions.explanation: take notes 固定搭配；主语 she 三单

questions.stem: Please ___ up the test environment today.
questions.explanation: set up 搭建（set up the environment）

questions.stem: Did you ___ my point, or should I explain again?
questions.explanation: get my point = 懂我的意思（get it）

questions.stem: The intern will ___ over the maintenance tasks next month.
Don't ___ the same mistake twice.
questions.explanation: make the same mistake（mistake 与 make 搭配）

questions.stem: Let's ___ a reminder for the release day.
He wants to ___ better at debugging.
questions.explanation: get better at + 技能（变强）

practice.title: 搭配判断 — ✅ 地道 / ❌ 假搭配，假搭配请改正

questions.stem: do a decision
questions.explanation: do 不与 decision 搭配

questions.stem: take notes
questions.explanation: take notes 记笔记 — 地道

questions.stem: make sense
questions.explanation: make sense 说得通 — 地道

questions.stem: get the responsibility for this module
questions.correction: take the responsibility for this module

questions.stem: keep in touch
questions.explanation: keep in touch 保持联系 — 地道

questions.stem: She makes always notes during the standup.
questions.reference: She always takes notes during the standup.
questions.explanation: 频度副词位于实义动词前；notes 与 take 搭配

questions.stem: He run the tests yesterday.
questions.explanation: run 不规则过去式 ran（L02 形态表）

questions.stem: We need to do a decision now.
questions.reference: We need to make a decision now.

practice.title: 我的一天 — 用 get / take / make / set / keep / run 各写一句，描述你真实的一天（6 句）

questions.stem: 用 get / take / make / set / keep / run 各写一句，描述你真实的一天（6 句）。

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: 6 句各用指定动词的一个课文或拓展搭配；不能自造搭配

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: 逐句回查 2.1 / 2.2 搭配网；形态正确（过去式 get→got、make→made、set→set、keep→kept、run→ran）

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 6 句搭配均能在 2.1 / 2.2 搭配网中找到且形态正确，即通过

practice.title: 弱动词升级 — 把下列「be + 形容词/名词」句改写成搭配句

questions.stem: I am responsible for the release.（take ...）
answers: I take responsibility for the release.

questions.stem: The meeting is at 9. Please arrive on time.（make ...）
answers: The meeting is at 9. Please make it on time.
questions.explanation: make it = 赶到 / 做到

questions.stem: Don't be angry about the bug.（get ...）
answers: Don't get angry about the bug.
questions.explanation: get + 形容词 = 变得（状态变化）
